2609.34460.title: When Does Structured Knowledge Help Neural Theorem Proving?
2609.34460.paper_summary: Does structured mathematical knowledge help LLMs prove theorems in Lean 4? If so, for which models, and does the answer vary by problem? Formal libraries such as Mathlib encode 285,000+ verified theorems with syntactic dependencies, but the semantic layer mathematicians rely on for discovery (analogies, generalizations, cross-domain bridges) remains implicit. We introduce MathAgent, which builds this layer as a knowledge graph, MathKG, and uses it to augment LLM theorem provers. MathKG connects 364 Mathlib theorems and definitions by 9,434 typed semantic edges inferred via LLM-based relation extraction anchored to verified Mathlib declarations. We run a controlled ablation across four augmentation modes (no context, knowledge-graph context, Mathlib retrieval, both) and five models: Qwen3-8B/32B, their Lean-specialized derivatives Goedel-Prover-V2-8B/32B, and Claude Sonnet 4.6, on miniF2F, plus PutnamBench and MathOlympiadBench for Sonnet. Three findings emerge. (i) Specialization dominates augmentation: Lean fine-tuning adds 33-38 percentage points of solve rate in every mode, and a specialized 8B model beats a $4\times$ larger general one by 29-35 points, while no augmentation mode improves solve rate by more than 3 points. (ii) Augmentation is capability-conditioned: knowledge-graph context helps small models but hurts large ones, with the specialized model gaining more relative to its general base at every scale. (iii) Yet the augmentation modes solve different problems: an oracle selecting the best mode per problem solves 6% to 58% more than the unaugmented prover, a complementarity effect that strengthens on harder problems (32% more on PutnamBench). These results motivate adaptive strategies that select augmentation by model capability and problem. Code, data, and artifacts are available at https://github.com/sarehnabi/mathagent
2609.34460.paper_summary_zh: 結構化的數學知識是否有助於 LLM 在 Lean 4 中證明定理？如果有，對於哪些模型，答案是否因問題而異？正式庫如 Mathlib 編碼了超過 285,000 個經過驗證的定理，並具有語法依賴性，但數學家在發現過程中依賴的語義層（類比、概括、跨領域橋接）仍然是隱含的。我們介紹了 MathAgent，它將這一層構建為知識圖譜 MathKG，並利用它來增強 LLM 定理證明器。MathKG 通過 9,434 條類型化語義邊連接了 364 個 Mathlib 定理和定義，這些邊是通過基於 LLM 的關係提取推斷出來的，並以經過驗證的 Mathlib 聲明為基礎。我們在四種增強模式（無上下文、知識圖譜上下文、Mathlib 檢索、兩者皆有）和五個模型上進行了控制性消融實驗：Qwen3-8B/32B、它們的 Lean 專用衍生模型 Goedel-Prover-V2-8B/32B，以及 Claude Sonnet 4.6，使用 miniF2F，還有 PutnamBench 和 MathOlympiadBench 用於 Sonnet。三個發現浮現出來。(i) 專業化主導增強：Lean 微調在每種模式下增加了 33-38 個百分點的解決率，而一個專用的 8B 模型比一個 $4\times$ 大的通用模型高出 29-35 個點，且沒有任何增強模式能使解決率提高超過 3 個點。(ii) 增強是能力條件的：知識圖譜上下文對小模型有幫助，但對大模型有害，專用模型在每個規模上相對於其通用基礎獲得了更多的增益。(iii) 然而，增強模式解決不同的問題：一個選擇每個問題最佳模式的神諭者比未增強的證明器多解決 6% 到 58% 的問題，這是一種互補效應，對於更難的問題（在 PutnamBench 上多出 32%）更為強化。這些結果促使我們採取適應性策略，根據模型能力和問題選擇增強。代碼、數據和文檔可在 https://github.com/sarehnabi/mathagent 獲得。
